audio_description:
Balamb Garden's underside passes low over a marina of masts.
It surges through the sea, throwing up white spray.

context.scene_title: Balamb Garden plows into the harbor — the mobile Garden arriving at the coastal town (Fishermans Horizon), Disc 2.
locations: A harbor/marina full of sailboat masts beside a coastal town, the Garden moving through the water
context.summary: The underside of Balamb Garden passes low over a marina crowded with sailboat masts, then the great structure surges through the sea throwing up a wall of white spray, seen past an ornamental iron railing — the drifting Garden grinding to a halt at the coastal town.
context.context_note: Read as the mobile Garden's arrival/collision at the coastal town (Fishermans Horizon); the marina is visible but the town is identified from context.
